blocks.text: Learn from those who taught the Word.
The preachers and writers whose sermons and books are in the site’s library, and the scholars whose work the site is built on.
Five centuries of Baptist, Reformed and evangelical pastors and preachers, from Bullinger to today: what they preached, where they served and who taught whom.
Historians, translators, archaeologists and the makers of the reference books this site stands on, Christian or not, each labelled for what they were.
Every work links to where it can be read; every scholar shows how this site uses their work.
Rooted in Scripture. Open for discovery.
A place to read slowly, ask deeply, and follow the connections. Scripture, study and the voices of Christian history, brought together for a lifetime of learning.
A library with a paper trail.
Meet the authors. Explore the collection. Trace each work to its source.
